symptom: CE7247 "The name 'X' is a reserved word." on non-persistent entity attributes (Owner/Type/Context/Id/CreatedDate/ChangedDate/ChangedBy) — mxcli accepts the MDL silently, Studio Pro rejects the project
cause: `ValidateEntity` early-returned for NPEs; reserved-word check was not wired into the executor
insight: Drop the `EntityPersistent` early-return; gate only `mendixSystemAttributeNames` (MDL020) to persistent; run `mendixReservedWords` (MDL021) for all kinds; call `ValidateEntity` from `execCreateEntity` before any backend write. Issue #552
